title: CLIVE's voice uses the clock it already has
requested_outcome: CLIVE already receives the time in London as the first line of every turn ('[Now: Thursday 1 October 2026, 15:13 Europe/London]', _now_line in app/routes/turn.py). The voice layer added on 1 October (PERSONALITY in app/kb/loader.py) wrongly says 'Mention the time only when a tool or the owner gave it to you: you have no clock of your own', which stops the owner's time-aware lines from his voice spec (a late-night remark, a warning that a send is late). Replace that one line so CLIVE knows the first line of each message is the current time in London and may use it for a time-aware remark, still bound by the existing humour rules. Correct docs/product-memory/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-01.md, whose 'A clock' paragraph says CLIVE has no clock: say the [Now: ...] line already exists and the voice now uses it. Nothing else in the prompt, the turn path or what reaches the model may change.
acceptance_criteria: PERSONALITY in app/kb/loader.py no longer says CLIVE has no clock; it says the first line of each message gives the current time in London and that CLIVE may use it for a time-aware remark.

A time-aware remark stays inside the existing humour rules: at most once, and never in bad news, failures, anything involving money, anything a customer reads, or anything waiting for the owner's gesture.
No other line of PERSONALITY or SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE changes, and app/routes/turn.py is not changed.
docs/product-memory/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-01.md no longer says CLIVE has no clock and records that the [Now: ...] line already reaches the model every turn.
tests/test_kb.py pins the new line and that 'no clock of your own' is gone from the prompt; tests/test_kb.py, tests/test_every_turn_is_the_model.py and tests/test_product_memory_structure.py pass.
